svg.title: Proper fibre restriction and the natural hypercohomology edge

cc:Work.dc:title: Proper fibre restriction and the natural hypercohomology edge
cc:Work.dc:description: Panel A shows the exact proper product model [-1,1] x R and the canonical compact-fibre restriction comparison. Panel B shows good truncations, the finite bounded-below filtration, and the edge/restriction triangle; only the edge gains an isomorphism under cohomology-sheaf acyclicity.
